name: Full card number, expiry and CVV capture
description: A message asks the recipient to disclose their full card number, expiry and CVV, typically under a re-verification or suspension pretext. Banks never ask for these.

source_references.quote: banks and other payment systems operators never ask for details such as password, PIN, OTP, CVV number

explanation.plain: You were asked to share your full card number, expiry and CVV. Your bank never asks for these — anyone who does is trying to steal from your card.
explanation.technical: Card/CVV disclosure request (credential-action) with a pressure or channel indicator. RBI: institutions never ask for card/CVV.
verification_steps: Never type your full card number, expiry or CVV into a link or share them by message.
Use the number on the back of your card to check with your bank.

provenance.notes: Encoded in the WP3 rule-encoding pass; suppression via negative-indicator-library-v1.json.
